{{Quote|The Cathar are a respected species and many ''great'' Jedi have come from ''my'' world!|Sylvar|<ref name="TotJ:DLotS">[[Tales of the Jedi: Dark Lords of the Sith (audio drama)|''Tales of the Jedi: Dark Lords of the Sith'' audio drama]]</ref>}}
The '''Cathar''' were a [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Feline/Legends|feline]], bipedal [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoids]] native to [[Cathar (location)/Legends|Cathar]], a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Savanna/Legends|savannas]] and rough uplands. They were known for their loyalty, passion, and temper. Quick and powerful, they were considered great [[Soldier/Legends|warriors]] and dedicated, efficient [[Diet/Legends|predators]].

Cathar had high moral values, learned from both family and society. Their [[Gender/Legends|females]] were prized as [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]], whereas the males were generally regarded as too uncontrollable for slavery.

==Biology and appearance==
[[File:SylvarAndEscorts-TOTJR2.jpg|thumb|left|250px|[[Sylvar]], a Cathar female, and two Cathar males of the more common subspecies]]
The baseline Cathar had [[Hair/Legends|fur]]-covered bodies with thick manes. They had prominent, retractable [[Claw/Legends|claws]] that could deliver powerful killing attacks on foes and prey. On average, Cathar were 1.5 to 1.9 meters tall. These traits made them the perfect [[Unarmed combat/Legends|hand-to-hand]] specialists.

The Cathar species had two [[Subspecies/Legends|subspecies]], known as the [[Juhani (subspecies)|Juhani]] and the [[Myr Rho]]. Both of these were notably less [[Cat/Legends|cat]]like than mainline Cathar.<ref name="PH">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/PHCathar|series=Planet Hoppers|text=Cathar}}</ref>

Cathar were [[Reproduction/Legends|born]] into a [[Litter (biology)|litter]].<ref name="Legacy 25">[[Legacy (2006) 25|''Legacy'' (2006) 25]]</ref> The Cathar species was biologically similar to the [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] species.

==Society and culture==
On their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]], Cathar lived in cities built into giant [[Tree/Legends|trees]], and were organized into clans governed by "[[Elder (title)/Legends|Elders]]." Stories of their great heroes were often carved into the trunks of these tree-homes for following generations to see. The Cathar [[Reproduction/Legends|mated]] for life, to the extent that when one mate died, the survivor never had a relationship with another. Cathar clan society included great pageants and celebrations, especially for their heroes. Their religion included a ritual known as the "[[Blood Hunt/Legends|Blood Hunt]]," in which Cathar [[Soldier/Legends|warriors]] individually engaged in combat against entire nests of [[Kiltik]] in order to gain honor and purge themselves of inner darkness. The native [[Language/Legends|language]] of the Cathar was [[Catharese]], which included the emphasis of some words spoken with a growl.

==History==
The planet of [[Cathar (location)/Legends|Cathar]] was devastated by the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] during the [[Battle of Cathar]], leading to the enslavement and near-extinction of the Cathar species. Over 90 percent of the species was killed by the Mandalorians in the battle.<ref name="The Essential Atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> The few survivors were forced to flee off-world to survive. After the [[Mandalorian Wars]], Cathar began to resettle their world. By the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], it had fully recovered from the damage the Mandalorians had done.

With the return of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Great Galactic War]], most Cathar sided with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. By the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], many Cathar had settled on [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]]. Others attempted to settle on [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] to aid in its [[Taris Resettlement Initiative|rebuilding]], but were attacked by the Sith Empire just prior to the [[Galactic War|outbreak of hostilities]]. As conflict was renewed with the [[Galactic War]], Cathar support for the Republic began to mildly diminish due to galactic events.

The Sith Empire had liberated a Cathar [[Shange|political prisoner]] and his followers who were covertly imprisoned on [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]] for twenty years at the behest of the [[Republic Strategic Information Service]]. This incident was leaked by [[Imperial Non-human Relations]], which damaged the public trust between the Republic and their alien citizens. After [[Battle of Ilum|Malgus' betrayal]], the Sith Empire began an alien initiative which saw multiple Cathar clans being freely inducted into the ranks.<ref name="SWTOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>

==Cathar in the galaxy==
[[File:CatharJediDrawCloser-JATM.jpg|thumb|right|240px|A Cathar Jedi]]
[[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] Cathar often became [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], even though the Jedi way tended to be in opposition to their natural tendencies. [[Sylvar]] and her mate [[Crado]] were famous Jedi who fought in the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]]. The story of Crado's fall to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]] under the influence of [[Exar Kun/Legends|Exar Kun]] was well-known to all Cathar, as was the story of Sylvar, who was able to turn away from the dark path and regain the Jedi way. Another Cathar Jedi of that era was [[Juhani]], who traveled with [[Revan/Legends|Revan]] and assisted him in the destruction of the [[Star Forge]].<ref name="Kotor">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]''</ref> Famous Cathar Jedi during the [[Second Imperial Civil War]] were brothers [[Rasi Tuum|Rasi]], [[Ahn Rasi Tuum|Ahn]] and [[Zho Rasi Tuum|Zho Tuum]].

==Behind the scenes==
The Cathar were created by [[Tom Veitch]] and [[Kevin J. Anderson]] for the characters Crado and Sylvar in ''[[Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi – Dark Lords of the Sith|Tales of the Jedi - Dark Lords of the Sith]]''. In [[2006]], a winning [[What's The Story?]] entry written by [[Captain Yossarian]] identified [[Myhr Rho]] as a catlike patron of the [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina/Legends|Mos Eisley Cantina]] in ''[[The Star Wars Holiday Special]]''. The entry also identified Rho's species as Cathar, thus establishing the ''Holiday Special'' as the first appearance of the Cathar species.

In [[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic|''Knights of the Old Republic'']], the Cathar [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Juhani]] speaks [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]], albeit with a heavy [[Wikipedia:Slavic languages|Slavic]]-like accent, with rolled "r"s and "w"s that sound like "v"s.<ref name="Kotor" /> [[Murghir]], a bounty hunter and foe in the Great Hunt encountered by the [[Hunter (individual)|Bounty Hunter class]] in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', also speaks with the same accent; however, a Cathar companion of the [[Meteor (Havoc Squad)|Trooper class]] in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', [[Aric Jorgan]], and a Cathar Jedi Master, [[Ryen]], do not.<ref name="SWTOR" />
